parsed.explanation: The quoted passage asserts the indispensable all-n tree-component inequality without proving it. The edge-count argument, selection of an acyclic component, bipartition, and derivation that its signed segment sum is bounded by the rank-pair slacks (plus the unpaired part) are all omitted. Section 3 only supplies the later lower bound on a nonzero signed sum, while the lower-bound conclusion merely invokes Lemma 4. Thus no other passage establishes L3.3, and supplying the missing argument requires a substantive lemma-level proof.
